# Instructions for accurately documenting failed electrical appliance safety checks

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Document the date and time of the safety check.
3. Write the name and model of the appliance being tested.
4. Record the tester’s name or identification.
5. Describe in detail the procedure followed during the test.
6. Note any visual inspection irregularities before testing.
7. Use a checklist to ensure all steps were followed as per regulations.
8. Record the results of each test performed and any deviations from the standard.
9. Document any failed tests or results that show non-compliance.
10. Include any error codes or warnings that were displayed.
11. Take photographs if possible to document the failure.
12. Outline the specific reason(s) for the failure.
13. Record whether the appliance poses a current safety risk.
14. Note whether immediate action is required to ensure safety.
15. Include recommendations for repair, replacement, or further testing.
16. Record any actions taken following the failed safety check.
